tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and default section ground. Ink reads on it at 13:1.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, nav links, secondary buttons, accordions, the Services band. Ink reads on it at 14:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, every border and every hard shadow. Also the Marquee and Footer ground. Never use pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text such as notes, captions and placeholder labels, on surface (6:1) and surface-raised (6.8:1).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Primary color. Primary buttons, the Proof band ground, step numerals. Carries on-slate text (6.9:1). Never put ink text on slate (2:1).

tokens.name: on-slate
tokens.usage: Text and marks on slate fills.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Highlight. The Highlight chip in headlines, the winning SERP row, the featured card, the nav call button, the final CTA box. Always with ink text (7.4:1).

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Support. Browser bar in the SERP mock, number badges, small meta tags. Always with ink text (10:1).

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Accent, used once or twice per screen: the logo chip, Stickers, the Most popular flag, strike-throughs in Before cards. Carries on-rust text (4.5:1).

tokens.name: on-rust
tokens.usage: Text on rust fills.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline only, one per page. Scales down to 46px on mobile with clamp(46px, 6.6vw, 92px).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headlines, max width about 820px. clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat cards and prices.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Hero and section intro paragraphs, max width 520 to 620px.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, SERP result details, notes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tiny nudges, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between nav links, inside tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tag and eyebrow padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on large cards, desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space between a section headline block and its content grid; hero column gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every section on desktop (80px on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, tags, inputs. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Only Stickers and the browser dots in the SERP mock.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows in ink, no blur, ever.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Logo chip, accordions.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, eyebrow highlights, stat cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Featured pricing card, process strip.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Hero SERP mock and the final CTA box, the two biggest objects on the page.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: Hover and active state of buttons, paired with translate(3px, 3px).

border.note: Borders are always ink and always solid, except dividers inside a component.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Every outer border: buttons, cards, nav, sections that change ground.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Inner elements: tags inside cards, browser dots, dashed dividers.

tilt.note: Small rotations add the handmade feel. Max one tilted object per group.

tokens.name: tilt-highlight
tokens.usage: The Highlight chip in headlines.

tokens.name: tilt-card
tokens.usage: The one featured card in a row.

tokens.name: tilt-sticker
tokens.usage: Stickers and flags, positive or negative depending on corner.
